nodes.label: Docker Deployment
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage Docker build producing single image pushed to GHCR. Production deployments use pre-built image via docker-compose.yml. Stateless container; rollback by pinning previous image tag.

nodes.label: CI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Triggers on push to main and workflow_dispatch. Runs pytest and ruff check, builds multi-arch Docker image, pushes to GHCR with computed tags. Image only pushed if tests pass.
